description: BELGIUM. The same purchase compared across Brussels-Capital, Wallonia and Flanders: registration duty, notary, other costs, total and its share of the price, with each Region's median house and apartment price (Statbel). Registration duties are regional; the notary tariff is federal.

flemish_core_city.description: Flanders only: the home is in a core city (centrumstad) or the Flemish Periphery (Vlaamse Rand). Default false.

sole_home.description: Sole and own home (you will live there and own no other home). Default true. False = normal rates.

name: compare_regions_be
title: Belgian purchase costs and prices compared across the three Regions
